resolutions.summary: Preserved the fork's split runtime, setup, server, prompt, lifecycle, localization, and launcher modules while importing the v5.0.7 behavior into their owning files.
Extra High is observed and persisted independently from Pro and fails closed for legacy observations.
Lease expiry cancels daemon ownership before removing a browser surface and preserves bounded failure diagnostics.
Native Codex requests use the launcher-owned system proxy resolver; model catalog failures are recorded without request content.
Added content-free MCP call observations and preserved native command approval arguments only when the advertised tool supports them.
Trimming preserves the newest cumulative checkpoint and explicitly marks omitted history.
Kept Enhanced documentation, added Korean and Traditional Chinese launcher language support, and clarified all context controls.
Upstream file-boundary changes were not copied where the fork already owns equivalent split production primitives.
